description: This file provides shell functions and configuration for integrating Git repository status into the shell prompt. It supports both Bash and Zsh shells and enables displaying current branch, status flags, upstream divergence, and other repository information directly in the prompt.

methods.name: __git_ps1
methods.description: Main function that constructs and outputs the Git status string for prompt integration, with support for formatting, colorization, and different shells.

methods.name: __git_ps1_show_upstream
methods.description: Helper that determines divergence from upstream branch, including ahead/behind counts and descriptive info.

methods.name: __git_ps1_colorize_gitstring
methods.description: Injects color codes into the Git status string based on branch state.

methods.name: __git_sequencer_status
methods.description: Checks if a cherry-pick, rebase, or other sequencer operation is in progress to update prompt accordingly.
